parts.text: Transition elements are found in the middle block of the Periodic Table.

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) Chromium has several isotopes. Manganese has only one isotope.

parts.label: iii
parts.text: (iii) Complete the table to show the number of protons, neutrons and electrons in a 52 Cr 3+ 24 ion. protons neutrons electrons [3]

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) One chemical property of transition elements is that they form coloured compounds.

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) Transition elements and Group I elements are metals. They share many physical properties including the ability to: ● conduct electricity ● be hammered into shape.

parts.label: d
parts.text: (d) Transition elements and Group I elements differ in other physical properties. Transition elements are harder and stronger than Group I elements.
